---
name: Report
about: A bug, risk, or improvement, including one found while working on something else
---

## Summary

<!--
Two to four plain sentences: what is wrong or missing, and who notices it
(users, admins, operators). Describe behavior, not code: no file paths, links to
files, or function names. Keep the whole issue under 150 words.
-->

## Impact

<!-- One line: what happens if this is left alone, and how soon it matters. -->

## Evidence

<!--
How you know: what you observed, how to see it again, and where it shows up,
such as a page, an API endpoint, a workflow, or an operation. Say what you have
not confirmed.
-->
